hindi: उपनिधि की व्याख्या ऋण से की गई।
english: The upanidhi is explained by the debt (ṛṇa).

words.gloss: by enemy's troops and forest chief
in the plundering of fort and country
in the plundering of village, caravan and cattle-station
in the destruction of the wheel-yoked
in an affliction by fire and water in the middle of a village
when hindered by the rush of flames

hindi: शत्रु की सेना और आटविक द्वारा दुर्ग और देश की लूट में, अथवा प्रतिरोधकों द्वारा गाँव, सार्थ और व्रज की लूट में, चक्रयुक्त के नाश में, अथवा गाँव के बीच अग्नि और जल की बाधा में, ज्वाला के वेग से रुके हुए में, अथवा नाव के डूब जाने या लुट जाने पर, स्वयं अभिभूत होकर उपनिधि की भरपाई न करे।
english: [In case of] the plundering of the fort and country by the enemy's troops and forest chief, or the plundering of village, caravan and cattle-station by robbers, or the destruction of the wheel-yoked, or an affliction by fire and water in the middle of a village, or [when he is] hindered by the rush of flames, or when the boat has sunk or been robbed, [if he is] himself overtaken, he should not make good the upanidhi.
notes: cakra-yukta-nāśe is obscure: rendered literally 'destruction of the wheel-yoked' (low confidence). uparūḍhaḥ (upa-√ruh) rendered 'overtaken' (alternative: 'come upon, affected'). The 'in case of' is supplied in brackets in English only. para-cakra-āṭavikābhyām: para-cakra = enemy's troops, āṭavika = forest chief (dvandva).

hindi: उपनिधि का उपभोग करने वाला देश और काल के अनुरूप उपभोग का वेतन और बारह पण का दण्ड दे।
english: The user of the upanidhi should give pay for the use, suited to place and time, and a penalty of twelve paṇas.
notes: deśa-kāla-anurūpam could agree with bhoga-vetanam (as rendered) or be adverbial. bhoga = use (enjoyment).

hindi: उपभोग के कारण नष्ट अथवा विनष्ट की भरपाई करे, और चौबीस पण का दण्ड है, अथवा अन्यथा निष्पतन में।
english: He should make good [the thing] lost or destroyed on account of use, and the penalty is twenty-four paṇas; or otherwise, in the niṣpatana (falling out).
notes: The object of abhyāvahet is not stated (naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ taken as the lost or destroyed thing). The last phrase 'anyathā vā niṣpatane' is elliptical: literally 'or otherwise, in the falling out'; niṣpatana is obscure (compare niṣpātana in unit 7).

words.gram: m./n. acc. sg. p.p. pra-√i (as printed)

hindi: मृतक अथवा व्यसन में पड़ा हुआ उपनिधि की भरपाई न करे।
english: The deceased or one fallen into calamity should not make good the upanidhi.
notes: The accusative pretaṃ vyasana-gataṃ is unexplained as printed: it may be an accusative agreeing with the upanidhi's owner or holder (the sense being that no one is to make good for the deceased or the fallen), or a loose accusative absolute. Rendered literally; who is meant is doubtful.

words.gloss: in pledging, selling and spending away

hindi: इसके बन्धक रखने, विक्रय और अपव्यय में चार गुना पञ्च-बन्ध दण्ड है।
english: And for pledging, selling and spending away of this, the penalty is four times the pañca-bandha.
notes: pañca-bandha is kept untranslated (obscure; literally 'five-binding'); catur-guṇa-pañca-bandha could also be read 'fourfold, five-bandha'. apavyayana = literally 'spending away'. asya is read as 'of this' (the thing in question, i.e. the upanidhi); ādhāna here is the act of pledging.

words.gloss: in the causing to fall out

hindi: परिवर्तन अथवा निष्पातन में मूल्य के समान।
english: In exchange or in niṣpātana (causing to fall out) [the penalty is] equal to the value.
notes: Verbless; 'the penalty is' is supplied in brackets in English only. niṣpātana is obscure; rendered literally.

words.gloss: the loss, use, sale, pledging and misappropriation of the pledge

hindi: इससे बन्धक के नाश, उपभोग, विक्रय, बन्धक रखने और अपहरण की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the loss, use, sale, pledging and misappropriation of the pledge (ādhi) are explained.
notes: ādhi = pledge (Hindi बन्धक) and ādhāna = the act of pledging; the glossary gives ādhāna = pledge, so the two words are distinguished here. Whether ādhi qualifies all the members of the dvandva is assumed.

hindi: उपकार सहित बन्धक नष्ट न हो, और इसका मूल्य न बढ़े, निसर्ग को छोड़कर।
english: A pledge with benefit should not perish, and its value should not increase, except from nisarga (release).
notes: sīdet (√sad) rendered 'perish' (literally 'sink'); upakāra = benefit (alternatively 'service'); nisarga rendered 'release' (doubtful; also 'grant, handing over'). The sa-upakāra join is printed with a hyphen, so two entries.

hindi: उपकार-रहित नष्ट हो, और इसका मूल्य बढ़े।
english: [A pledge] without benefit should perish, and its value should increase.
notes: The subject (ādhi) is carried over from unit 9.

words.gloss: of one who has presented himself

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-pra-√yam

hindi: उपस्थित हुए को बन्धक न देने वाले को बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: For one not handing over the pledge to [the man] who has presented himself, the penalty is twelve paṇas.

text_flags.why: stray ṇ in the printed compound; read dvādaśa.paṇaḥ

notes: Two genitives (upasthitasya, aprayacchataḥ): taken as 'of the one who has presented himself' (the redeemer) and 'of the one not giving back'; the sense in English is the usual one but the Sanskrit is literally compressed.

words.gloss: in the absence of the lender

hindi: अथवा प्रयोजक की अनुपस्थिति में ग्राम के वृद्धों के पास निष्क्रय रखकर बन्धक को वापस ले।
english: Or, in the absence of the lender, having placed the redemption with the village elders, he should take back the pledge.
notes: prayojaka rendered 'lender' (the one who puts out the money), medium confidence; Hindi keeps प्रयोजक. niṣkraya = redemption, i.e. what redeems the pledge (not stated as money).

words.gloss: its value fixed at that time

hindi: वृद्धि से निवृत्त हुआ बन्धक, उस समय निश्चित मूल्य वाला, वहीं रहे, अथवा अनाश-विनाश-करण से अधिष्ठित।
english: Or the pledge, whose increase has ceased and whose value is fixed at that time, should remain right there; or [it is] placed under anāśa-vināśa-karaṇa.
notes: anāśa-vināśa-karaṇa-adhiṣṭhitaḥ is obscure (anāśa 'non-loss', vināśa 'destruction', karaṇa 'doing/instrument/document'); kept literal, low confidence; the reading 'placed under [a person/means] for non-loss and destruction' is only one possibility.

words.gloss: in the absence of the debtor
having the trust of the pledge-keeper

hindi: अथवा धारणिक की अनुपस्थिति में विनाश के भय से, मूल्य बढ़ जाने पर, धर्मस्थ की अनुमति से बेच दे, अथवा आधि-पाल के विश्वास से।
english: Or, in the absence of the debtor, from fear of loss, [the holder], permitted by the dharmastha, should sell it when its price has risen; or [he may do so] with the trust of the pledge-keeper.
notes: dhāraṇika rendered 'debtor' (medium confidence); the subject (the holder of the pledge) and 'it' are supplied in brackets in English only. pratyaya read as 'trust'; alternatives 'confirmation, guarantee'.

words.gloss: to be enjoyed by its fruit
cleared of investment, increase and value

hindi: स्थावर तो प्रयास से भोग्य अथवा फल से भोग्य, प्रक्षेप, वृद्धि और मूल्य से शुद्ध जीविका को मूल्य की हानि के बिना ला दे।
english: But the immovable [pledge], to be enjoyed by labour or to be enjoyed by its fruit, he should bring in the livelihood cleared of investment, increase and value, without loss of value.
notes: Compressed text. ājīva = livelihood (the sense 'profit/income' only in notes). upanayet 'should bring in' (also 'credit, apply'). amūlya-kṣayeṇa read 'without loss of value'; the a- could be read as a privative of mūlya-kṣaya. prakṣepa rendered 'investment' (literally 'throwing in'). The object-pledge 'sthāvaraḥ' is masculine and supplied noun 'pledge' is in brackets.

hindi: अनिसृष्ट का उपभोग करने वाला मूल्य से शुद्ध जीविका और बन्ध दे।
english: One who uses [it] without permission should give the livelihood cleared of value, and the bandha.
notes: anisṛṣṭa rendered 'not permitted' (literally 'not released'); bandha kept (literally 'binding', as in pañca-bandha, unit 6), sense doubtful.

hindi: शेष की व्याख्या उपनिधि से की गई।
english: The remainder is explained by the upanidhi.

hindi: इससे आदेश और अन्वाधि की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By this, ādeśa and anvādhi are explained.
notes: ādeśa and anvādhi are kept as printed (obscure terms, not translated).

hindi: सार्थ के साथ अन्वाधि हाथ में लिए हुए, अथवा निर्दिष्ट भूमि तक न पहुँचा हुआ, अथवा चोरों द्वारा तोड़ा और छोड़ा हुआ अन्वाधि की भरपाई न करे।
english: One with the anvādhi in hand [travelling] with a caravan, or one who has not reached the assigned ground, or one broken and abandoned by robbers, should not make good the anvādhi.
notes: Bahuvrīhi anvādhi-hasta read literally 'having the anvādhi in hand'; the participial sārthena could also be read with the caravan as the means. The printed corair is coraiḥ before vowel/voiced sandhi.

hindi: अथवा बीच में मरे हुए का उत्तराधिकारी भी भरपाई न करे।
english: Or, in the meantime, even the heir of the dead man should not make good.
notes: antare read 'in the meantime / in the interval' (literally 'in the interval'); the object (the anvādhi) is not repeated.

hindi: शेष की व्याख्या उपनिधि से की गई।
english: The remainder is explained by the upanidhi.

text_flags.why: typo: stray a/h transposition; the parallel units 17, 24 and 31 read vyākhyātam

hindi: माँगा हुआ अथवा किराये पर लिया हुआ जिस प्रकार का लें, उसी प्रकार का सौंपें।
english: A borrowed or hired [thing], of whatever kind they take, of just that kind they should hand back.
notes: yācitaka 'borrowed' (asked for) and avakrītaka 'hired' (as in 5.2); the nouns are bracketed in English only. arpayeyuḥ 'hand over/ hand back' (literally 'cause to go to').

hindi: भ्रेष और उपनिपात से, देश और काल को रोकने वाला, दिया हुआ, नष्ट अथवा विनष्ट की वे भरपाई न करें।
english: [What is] given, lost or destroyed by bhreṣa and upanipāta, obstructing place and time, they should not make good.
notes: bhreṣa is kept untranslated; upanipāta rendered by the sense 'befalling' only in the gloss. deśa-kāla-uparodhi is obscure (literally 'obstructing place and time'): possibly 'conflicting with the stipulated place and time'; low confidence. The 'what is' is bracketed in English only.

hindi: शेष की व्याख्या उपनिधि से की गई।
english: The remainder is explained by the upanidhi.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. mid. part. vi-√krī

hindi: वैयावृत्य द्वारा विक्रय तो — वैयावृत्य करने वाले देश और काल के अनुसार बेचते हुए, पण्य को जैसा हुआ वैसा, मूल्य और उदय दें।
english: But as for sale by vaiyāvṛtya — the vaiyāvṛtya-doers, selling according to place and time, should give the value and the increase, as the wares have come about.
notes: vaiyāvṛtya is kept untranslated (obscure). yathā-jātam is ambiguous: it may qualify paṇyam ('the wares as they came about') or the giving; rendered with the last reading. udaya read 'increase' (also 'yield, profit'). The bare dash is a printed punctuation token.

words.gloss: in the passing beyond of place and time
of the time of handing over

hindi: देश और काल के अतिक्रमण में, अथवा घटे हुए में, सम्प्रदान के समय के मूल्य से मूल्य और उदय दें।
english: In the passing beyond of place and time, or [in the case of what is] diminished, they should give the value and the increase at the price of the time of handing over.
notes: Compressed. parihīṇam is read as a diminished (lost) quantity of the wares, bracketed 'what is'. The two words for price: argha 'price', mūlya 'value', kept apart.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. mid. part. vi-√krī

hindi: अथवा जैसा तय हुआ बेचते हुए उदय न पाएँ, मूल्य ही दें।
english: Or, [if] selling as agreed, they should not obtain the increase; they should give the value only.
notes: yathā-sambhāṣita = as agreed (as in 4.12). The 'if' is bracketed.

words.gloss: in the falling of the price

hindi: मूल्य गिरने पर, अथवा घटे हुए में, घटाव के अनुसार घटा हुआ मूल्य दें।
english: On a fall in the price, or [in the case of what is] diminished, they should give the value reduced according to the diminution.
notes: yathā-parihīṇam taken as an adverb ('according to the diminution'); the 'what is' is bracketed.

words.gloss: not to be spoken of to the king

hindi: व्यवहार-सम्बन्धी, अथवा विश्वास-सम्बन्धी, राजा से न कहे जाने योग्यों में भ्रेष और उपनिपात से नष्ट अथवा विनष्ट का मूल्य भी न दें।
english: Or, in those pertaining to dealings, in the trusted ones, [and] in those not to be spoken of to the king, [what is] lost or destroyed by bhreṣa and upanipāta, they should not give even the value.
notes: sāṃvyavahārika, prātyayika and arāja-vācya are obscure (the nouns they qualify are not stated); rendered literally ('pertaining to dealings', 'trusted/ based on trust', 'not to be spoken of to the king'), low confidence. In prātyayikeṣv the final -v is sandhi for prātyayikeṣu.

words.gloss: of those separated by place and time

hindi: देश और काल से व्यवधान को प्राप्त पण्यों का क्षय और व्यय से शुद्ध मूल्य और उदय दें, और पण्यों के समवायों का प्रत्येक अंश के अनुसार।
english: But of wares separated by place and time, they should give the value and the increase cleared of loss and expenditure; and of the associations of wares, per share.
notes: The second clause is verbless; the verb is carried over ('they should give'). The reading of cleared-of-loss/expenditure as qualifying mūlyam udayam is assumed. samavāya = association (as in mithaḥ-samavāya, unit 52).

hindi: शेष की व्याख्या उपनिधि से की गई।
english: The remainder is explained by the upanidhi.

hindi: इससे वैयावृत्य द्वारा विक्रय की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By this, the sale by vaiyāvṛtya is explained.

hindi: और निक्षेप उपनिधि से।
english: And the nikṣepa [is explained] by the upanidhi.
notes: Verbless; the predicate 'explained' (from the preceding units) is supplied in brackets in English only.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √ṛ

hindi: उसे, जो दूसरे द्वारा रखा गया, दूसरे को सौंपने वाले की हानि हो।
english: For one handing over to another that [deposit] deposited by another, [there] would be loss.
notes: anyasya-arpayataḥ: anyasya read as dative sense 'to another' (genitive form). hīyeta (passive of √hā, 'be deprived, fall short') leaves the subject open; who loses is not stated. tam is read as the deposit (nikṣepa).

words.gloss: in the misappropriation of a deposit

hindi: निक्षेप के अपहरण में पूर्व अपदान और निक्षेप करने वाले प्रमाण हैं।
english: In the misappropriation of a deposit, the earlier record and the depositors are the evidence.
notes: apadānam rendered 'record' (literally 'conduct, deed'); pramāṇam is singular for a plural subject.

hindi: क्योंकि कारु अशुद्ध हैं।
english: For artisans are impure.
notes: aśuci 'impure' is rendered literally (a moral sense 'not clean/ not trustworthy' is possible); kāru = artisan (as 3.5).

hindi: इनके लिए निक्षेप का धर्म प्रमाण से पूर्व वाला नहीं है।
english: For these, the rule of deposit is not preceded by a means of proof (karaṇa).
notes: karaṇa rendered 'means of proof' (as in 4.1); an alternative is 'document'. dharma here is 'rule', not dharma in the abstract sense.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. mid. part. apa-vi-√i

words.gloss: at the edge of the forest
by trust through the prahavaṇa with liquor

hindi: निक्षेप करने वाला, करण से रहित निक्षेप को छिपाने वाले को, गुप्त दीवार में रखे गए साक्षियों को, एकान्त में प्रणिपात से ज्ञान कराए, अथवा वन के किनारे मद्य और प्रहवण से उत्पन्न विश्वास से।
english: The depositor should make aware, in private and with prostration, the one denying a deposit lacking a means of proof, [and] the witnesses placed in a hidden wall; or at the edge of the forest, by trust through the prahavaṇa with liquor.
notes: Very compressed and doubtful: the syntax of the accusatives (the denier, the witnesses placed in a hidden wall) with prajñāpayet is unclear; the witnesses are placed 'in a wall' (bhitti) and may be those who overhear. apavyayamāna read as 'denying' (literally 'spending away, denying'). prahavaṇa is kept untranslated (obscure). madya = liquor. Low confidence.

hindi: एकान्त में कोई वृद्ध अथवा रोगी वैदेहक, चिह्न लगाया हुआ द्रव्य इसके हाथ में रखकर चला जाए।
english: In private, some old or sick trader, having deposited goods that are marked in his hand, might go away.
notes: vaidehaka rendered 'trader' (as in 12.2; not the caste name of 3.7). The scenario is the setting of the sentence; the subject of the whole passage is the depositor's witness-agent only by inference, not stated.

hindi: उसके प्रतिदेश से पुत्र अथवा भाई पास जाकर निक्षेप माँगे।
english: By his indication, a son or a brother, having approached, should ask for the deposit.
notes: pratideśa rendered 'indication' (also 'substitute, pointing out'); doubtful. tasya is the trader of unit 39.

hindi: देने में शुद्ध; अन्यथा निक्षेप और चोरी का दण्ड दे।
english: In giving, [he is] pure; otherwise he should give the deposit and the penalty for theft.
notes: śuci 'pure' is rendered literally ('clear' of liability).

hindi: अथवा प्रव्रज्या की ओर उन्मुख कोई विश्वसनीय, चिह्न लगाया हुआ द्रव्य इसके हाथ में रखकर प्रस्थान करे।
english: Or some trustworthy man, intent on pravrajyā (going forth), having deposited goods that are marked in his hand, might depart.
notes: pravrajyā rendered by its literal sense 'going forth'; the sense is that of renunciation but is not stated in the line.

words.gloss: come after an interval of time

hindi: तब समय के अन्तर से आया हुआ माँगे।
english: Then, come after an interval of time, he should ask [for it].
notes: The object (the deposit) is not repeated.

hindi: देने में शुद्ध; अन्यथा निक्षेप और चोरी का दण्ड दे।
english: In giving, [he is] pure; otherwise he should give the deposit and the penalty for theft.

hindi: अथवा चिह्न लगाए हुए द्रव्य से इसे वापस ले आए।
english: Or he should bring him back with the marked goods.
notes: pratyānayet 'bring back' (literally 'lead back'); whom 'enam' refers to is not stated (the holder of the goods, as inferred).

words.gloss: afraid of the moment of the king's dāyikā

hindi: अथवा बालिश जाति का, रात में राजा के दायिका के क्षण से डरा हुआ, बहुमूल्य वस्तुएँ इसके हाथ में रखकर चला जाए।
english: Or one of foolish kind, at night, afraid of the moment of the king's dāyikā, having deposited valuables in his hand, might go away.
notes: rāja-dāyikā-kṣaṇa is obscure; dāyikā is left untranslated (no sense assigned), kṣaṇa 'moment'. bāliśa-jātīya 'of foolish kind' (literally). sāra = valuables (as in 12.1).

hindi: वह बन्धन-गृह में गया हुआ इसे माँगे।
english: He, gone to the prison, should ask him.
notes: The first 'he' is the depositor of unit 46 (taken); 'ask' has no stated object; an alternative reading is 'ask for it' (the deposit).

hindi: देने में शुद्ध; अन्यथा निक्षेप और चोरी का दण्ड दे।
english: In giving, [he is] pure; otherwise he should give the deposit and the penalty for theft.

hindi: और पहचान से इसके घर में जन से दोनों माँगे।
english: And by the token, in his house, he should ask the person for both.
notes: ubhayam 'both' is not specified (the goods and the marks? two deposits?); the double accusative of √yāc is assumed. abhijñāna 'token' (also 'recognition').

hindi: दोनों में से किसी एक को लेने पर जैसा पहले कहा गया।
english: In the taking of either, as stated earlier.
notes: 'Either' refers to the two parties/deposits of units 46-49; the printed anyatarta may also stand for anyatarat.

hindi: और इसके द्रव्यों के भोगों की प्राप्ति के विषय में पूछताछ करे, और उस अर्थ के व्यवहार का उपलिङ्गन, और अभियोक्ता के अर्थ की सामर्थ्य।
english: And he should question [him] on his acquisition of the enjoyments of goods, [and take] the inference of the dealings in that matter, and the claimant's capacity in the matter.
notes: Compressed; the second and third items are verbless (the verb is carried over, bracketed). upaliṅgana 'inference' (literally 'marking by signs'), doubtful. anuyuñjīta = question (as in 4.7). The anusvāra-less printed 'dravya.bhogānām' is fine.

hindi: इससे पारस्परिक समवाय की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By this, the mutual association is explained.
notes: mithaḥ here 'mutually' (not 'privately' as in 5.4); samavāya = association.

words.gloss: by place, time, agra and varṇa

hindi: इसलिए साक्षी सहित, अगुप्त, भली-भाँति कहा हुआ करे; अपने या दूसरे जन के साथ कार्य देश, काल, अग्र और वर्ण के अनुसार करना चाहिए।
english: Therefore one should make it witnessed, unconcealed and well declared; the matter is to be done with one's own or another person, by place, time, agra and varṇa.
notes: agra and varṇa are kept untranslated (agra 'foremost, top'; varṇa 'colour, description'); the sense is doubtful. kuryāt has no stated object (the transaction); it is supplied as 'it'. sākṣimat, acchanna and samyag-vibhāṣita are read as qualifiers of that unstated object.
